title: 1RB1LB_1LC0RD_0LE1LA_0RF1RA_1LE0LA_---0RB: the left end is closed for any first-segment content
text: In the frame of the new blank cell, the first L cells depend only on the first L+3, and beyond them lies the first segment. Treating its cells as free (one class of 0s), the left-end states close (4,608 for L = 30) with no halt. With the right-end cycle, a halt now needs a segment turned entirely into 110 words where a lone 1 can use it.
